metadata.title: The Electric Mind: Why India's AI boom will be built in substations before server halls
metadata.description:
Abstract. A public thesis arguing that firm, high-quality power delivered to specific physical nodes will be a binding constraint on India's AI infrastructure build-out, with six dated forecasts for public scoring through 2032.

The paper argues that the relevant bottleneck is local grid delivery—substations, transmission, transformers, storage, metering and connection readiness—rather than national generation adequacy alone. It sets out a falsifiable forecast ledger and a public scoring commitment.

Version boundary. Version 1.2 assigns the materially revised calls new ledger identifiers EM-1201 through EM-1206. The original EM-001 through EM-006 entries remain frozen and scoreable. The companion public ledger is available at Mirror Ledger.

Evidence boundary. References were re-verified on 11 August 2026. The paper expressly identifies the claims that remain dependent on secondary reporting or an inferred measurement basis.

This is commentary and analysis, not professional or personalised investment advice, a solicitation, or a recommendation. It names no securities as recommendations and sets no target prices or portfolio weights.
